claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration.permanent
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Astral Projection has duration 'Permanent (ends on Dispel)'. The Duration union only covers instantaneous, concentration, and timed. A new variant { kind: 'permanent' } (or { kind: 'until_dispelled' }) is needed for this and similar indefinite spells (Imprisonment, Clone, Sequester).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: project_astral_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's primary effect splits each target into a body (left in suspended animation) and an astral form (on the Astral Plane). This is not transport_exile (which exiles an entity entirely) nor create_companion (which creates a separate NPC). It is a dual-entity split — the same creature exists simultaneously as a physical body on one plane and an astral form on another. No v4 atom models this concept.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Each target's body is left behind in a state of suspended animation... A target's astral form resembles its body in almost every way, replicating its game statistics and possessions."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: entity_link
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The silver cord establishes a bi-directional death link between the astral form and the body: if the cord is cut, both die; if either reaches 0 HP, the spell ends for that target. This is a linked-entity lifecycle constraint with no analogue in v4. The closest atom (expire) is unidirectional and time-based, not event-based with mutual destruction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If the cord is cut... the target's body and astral form both die. [...] If a target's body or astral form drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends for that target."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: inter_plane_reentry
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: When an astral form leaves the Astral Plane, the body and possessions teleport along the silver cord to the new plane. This is a conditional plane-crossing that moves the physical body — not a spell effect firing on exit, but a structural re-entry mechanic that reunites the dual entities. No existing subgraph or atom combination (transport_exile, release, expire) captures the 'body follows astral form when plane boundary is crossed' semantics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The moment an astral form leaves that plane, the target's body and possessions travel along the silver cord, causing the target to re-enter its body on the new plane."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition.unconscious
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell applies the Unconscious condition to each target's left-behind body. The Condition type is currently the literal 'prone' only. Unconscious is a standard SRD condition that will be needed for many other spells and effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "it has the Unconscious condition, doesn't need food or air, and doesn't age"
